heroHeadline: First Confirmed Gerbera Drone Crashes Near Cernița as Chisinau and Tiraspol Hold First Talks in Five Months
heroSubtitle: A camera-equipped Gerbera drone — the first of its type found on Moldovan territory — struck a tree and exploded in a field near Cernița, Florești district, on September 24, one of four airspace incursions the Defence Ministry reported that morning and the nineteenth confirmed breach since the crisis began August 9; no one was injured. President Sandu had disclosed two days earlier that Russian drones have entered Moldovan airspace 39 times in 2026, more than double 2025's full-year total of 17, as the EU commits EUR 120 million toward a new air-defense system. Separately, Moldovan Deputy PM Valeriu Chiveri and Tiraspol negotiator Vitali Ignatiev met at the OSCE's Tiraspol office on September 24 — their first formal session in over five months — agreeing to intensify technical dialogue on vehicle registration and a disputed school building, with a further meeting set before year-end.
